Name: Mattaniah, Ancestor of Jahaziel
Role: Levite of the Sons of Asaph
Summary: Mattaniah was the ancestor in Jahaziel's line: Jahaziel son of Zechariah, son of Benaiah, son of Jeiel, son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph.
KeyStory: Mattaniah is named only at the head of the line given when the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel.
RelatedPeople: Jahaziel, Son of Zechariah; Jeiel, Son of Mattaniah
LifeLesson: God's Spirit came to a man rooted in a long line of singers.
